general_tips: If you see a menu or PC screen that won't close with A, try pressing B to cancel
If stuck after multiple A presses, try moving in a direction (up/down/left/right)
The START button opens the main menu, which can help diagnose the game state
PC screens in Pokemon Centers are for storage - B exits them
When facing a wall and movement buttons don't work, turn around or try a different direction
In battles, A confirms moves and B backs out of menus
If you're in a building and can't move, look for doors (darker rectangles) and walk through them

tips: PC is on the right side - walk up to it and press A to interact
Press B to exit PC menus
Nurse is at the counter - talk to her to heal
common_issues: Getting stuck in PC menu - press B to exit

tips: Oak's lab is at the top
Exit to Route 1 is at the top of town
